curation.lead: Boris Nikolic is a Harvard-trained physician who served as Chief Science Advisor to Bill Gates at bgC3, Gates's private research office. Email records from the EFTA corpus document his contacts with Jeffrey Epstein between 2010 and 2019, spanning the Gates philanthropic network, Epstein's social circle, and the technology investment world [Finding #282][Finding #284][Finding #285]. A December 2010 message from Gates to Nikolic indicates Nikolic was the channel through which an early Gates–Epstein meeting was arranged [Finding #282]. In September 2013 Nikolic entered a formal financial partnership with Gates covering Foundation Medicine and ResearchGate investments, and eight days later attended an IPI–Gates Foundation meeting at the Redmond campus on a grant proposal Epstein had brokered [Finding #284][Finding #285]. Two days before Epstein's death in August 2019, Nikolic was named first-alternate successor trustee of the $577 million 1953 Trust; he declined to serve and publicly described the designation as a surprise [Finding #287].
curation.system_role: Chief Science Advisor at bgC3 with documented communications connecting Epstein to portions of the Gates philanthropic network and to Kimbal Musk; first-alternate successor trustee named in the Epstein 1953 Trust.

sections.title: Role at bgC3 and the Gates Foundation
sections.content:
Nikolic's formal relationship with Bill Gates ran through bgC3, Gates's private think tank and research office, where Nikolic held the title of Chief Science Advisor [Finding #285]. The role connected him to Gates Foundation scientific program officers and grantmaking workflows [Finding #285].

A December 2010 email from Gates to Nikolic reads: "I wont be able to do the dinner with Jeff Epstein. I was looking forward to the dinner. Nathan had agreed with you that I would enjoy meeting with him" [Finding #282][EFTA02410629]. The message documents that Nikolic was the routing contact for at least one planned Gates–Epstein meeting in 2010 [Finding #282].

On September 3, 2013, Gates and Nikolic executed a Letter of Agreement Regarding Purchase of Partnership Interest covering co-investments in Foundation Medicine and ResearchGate, with Nikolic serving as an observer board member at Foundation Medicine [Finding #284][EFTA02685163]. The partnership payment period was extended to September 3, 2018 by amendment dated October 6, 2015 [Finding #284]. The agreement appeared in Epstein's email corpus, which indicates it was shared with Epstein by one of the signatories or a person with access to Nikolic's files [Finding #284][EFTA02685163].

Eight days after the partnership was executed, on September 11, 2013, Nikolic attended the IPI–Gates Foundation meeting at the Gates campus in Redmond, listed on the agenda as "Scientific Advisor" [Finding #285][EFTA02725118]. The meeting concerned the International Peace Institute polio eradication grant proposal, which later became Gates Foundation grant OPP1096058 at $2.5 million [Finding #285]. Cross-reference of the September 2013 meeting agenda and the IPI grant record places Nikolic inside the Gates organization at the point where Epstein's IPI grant brokering intersected with Foundation review [Finding #285].

sections.title: Personal Relationship with Epstein
sections.content:
Cross-reference of seven EFTA email records from 2011–2015 indicates Nikolic's contacts with Epstein extended beyond the professional sphere [Finding #303]. Records show Nikolic transmitted an NDA for 9 East 71st Street, Epstein's Manhattan residence, to Epstein in April 2011 [Finding #303]. Cross-reference of records shows an August 6, 2013 email from Lesley Groff to Nikolic identifying the tail number of Epstein's plane and referencing Karyna Shuliak updating him on timing [Finding #303][EFTA02336502], with the body reading "The tail # Of Jeffrey's plane is N9091" and continuing "Karyna can update you tomorrow on exact ti=ing since she will be with" [Finding #303][EFTA02336502]. A breakfast at the 71st Street residence on July 11, 2015 is confirmed in the corpus [EFTA02497227].

On January 24, 2013, Nikolic emailed Epstein: "Yesterday, I wanted to punch a guy yesterday that does not like you. From Highbridge capital"; Epstein replied "better than punching him, get his name" [Finding #699][EFTA01908297]. The exchange shows Nikolic reporting perceived hostility toward Epstein inside a financial firm and Epstein requesting identification of the critic [Finding #699].

Records show that on June 15, 2015 Nikolic wrote to Epstein that his next message would introduce "=lya Ponamarov", described as "a member of Duma" [Finding #303][EFTA02360267]. Analysis of the referenced figure indicates Ilya Ponomarev was then a Russian State Duma member living in exile [Finding #303]. Review of the records shows no subsequent Epstein–Ponomarev correspondence has been identified in the corpus [Finding #303].

Cross-reference of seven EFTA records indicates Epstein obtained WEF Annual Meeting participant lists for 2011 and 2013 from Nikolic and used those contacts for introductions [Finding #160]. EFTA records show Nikolic emailing Epstein the WEF AM11 participants list on January 18 and January 19, 2011, and the WEF AM13 participants list on January 17, 2013 with the message "Pls check if =here is anyone that I should meet" [EFTA02686104][EFTA02686168][EFTA02707383]. Records show a June 27, 2014 email from Nicole Junkermann to Epstein stating "I spoke to boris he will do is bestand co-sponsor me but he had nominated...", which cross-reference of the seven-record synthesis identifies as Nikolic's role in a WEF nomination [Finding #160][EFTA02722698].

sections.title: Contacts Between Epstein and Kimbal Musk
sections.content:
Cross-reference of three EFTA email threads from 2012–2017 indicates Nikolic was the recurring contact point between Kimbal Musk and Epstein [Finding #4512]. Cross-reference of those threads produced the synthesis set out below [Finding #4512].

Records show a September 2012 email thread in which a gala invitation was routed through Nikolic to Epstein and associates [Finding #4512][EFTA02560007]. Records show an October 2012 exchange documenting a lunch at Epstein's 71st Street residence at which Kimbal Musk is recorded as an invitee, with logistics coordinated between Epstein's assistant Lesley Groff and Kimbal's assistant [Finding #4512][EFTA02565784]. Records show a February 2013 thread in which Kimbal Musk shared news of his divorce with Nikolic, who then relayed it to Epstein [Finding #4512][EFTA02358398]. Records show that in April 2017 Nikolic wrote to Epstein from TED: "Kimbal, elon, and few new interesting for you are around here" [Finding #4512].

A separate record documents that Epstein held $5 million in preferred stock in Jawbone (AliphCom), that Jawbone CEO Hosain Rahman corresponded directly with Epstein from at least 2013 through July 2018, and that Nikolic facilitated the Jawbone connection [Finding #4535][EFTA02252444][EFTA02397138][EFTA02715980]. Cross-reference of the Kimbal Musk correspondence and the Jawbone record indicates Nikolic was the recurring connective contact between Epstein's technology interests and several Silicon Valley principals during this period [Finding #4512][Finding #4535].

sections.title: Named in the Epstein Estate
sections.content:
The 1953 Trust, named for Epstein's birth year, was executed on August 8, 2019, two days before Epstein's death [Finding #287]. Primary trustees were Darren Indyke and Richard Kahn [Finding #287]. The trust instrument states: "BORIS NIKOLIC shall be appointed to fill any such vacancy, and if he is unwilling or unable to serve, BARNABY MARSH shall be appointed to fill any such vacancy" [Finding #287][EFTA01266204]. Nikolic publicly stated he was surprised by the designation and declined to serve [Finding #287].

The full succession chain set out in Finding #378 is Indyke and Kahn as primary trustees, Nikolic as first alternate, Barnaby Marsh as second, Anthony Barrett as third, Kathy Ruemmler as fourth, David Mitchell as fifth, Steve Hanson as sixth, and Eva Dubin as seventh [Finding #378]. The ordering places Nikolic ahead of Ruemmler, who had served as Epstein's lawyer for five years and was named trustee of a separate instrument [Finding #378]. The trust was executed forty-eight hours before Epstein's August 10, 2019 death at the Metropolitan Correctional Center [Finding #287][Finding #378].

sections.title: Network Position and Cross-Links
sections.content:
Cross-reference of connection records and findings identifies four clusters of Nikolic contacts in the Epstein graph [Finding #285][Finding #303][Finding #160].

Gates philanthropic network. Via bgC3, Nikolic had working access to Gates Foundation scientific advisory processes and grant pipelines, including the September 11, 2013 IPI–Gates meeting at which he was listed as Scientific Advisor [Finding #285][EFTA02725118]. He co-invested with Gates in Foundation Medicine and ResearchGate under the September 3, 2013 partnership agreement [Finding #284][EFTA02685163]. See Jeffrey Epstein and International Peace Institute.

Silicon Valley investment contacts. Connection records show a Thiel–Nikolic tie on a shared Epstein schedule in October 2014, with Thiel at 12 pm and Nikolic at 2 pm [EFTA02377982][EFTA02389290]. See Peter Thiel and Marc Andreessen.

Kimbal Musk and Jawbone. Cross-reference of the Kimbal Musk email threads and the Jawbone record is set out in the preceding section; see Kimbal Musk [Finding #4512][Finding #4535].

Apollo contacts. A connection record places Nikolic on an Epstein calendar shared with Joshua Harris during the documented period of Apollo’s engagement with Epstein [EFTA02578836]. See also Leon Black.

WEF participation. Records show EFTA emails from January 2011 and January 2013 in which Nikolic forwarded WEF Annual Meeting participant lists to Epstein [EFTA02686104][EFTA02686168][EFTA02707383]. Cross-reference of seven EFTA records indicates Nikolic also played a role in a WEF nomination for Nicole Junkermann alongside Larry Summers [Finding #160][EFTA02722698].

open_questions: What was the nature of Nikolic's contact with Ilya Ponomarev, the Russian Duma member he introduced to Epstein in June 2015? The introduction is documented [EFTA02360267] but no further Epstein–Ponomarev correspondence has been identified in the corpus.

Why was Nikolic designated first alternate trustee of the 1953 Trust in preference to Epstein's lawyers? Kathryn Ruemmler appears fourth in the succession chain despite having served as Epstein's counsel for five years. No explanation has appeared in court filings, public statements, or the email corpus.

What other Gates Foundation grant processes did Nikolic participate in during 2011–2019 beyond the IPI polio grant? His bgC3 role overlapped with Epstein's engagement with Gates, but the corpus documents the IPI grant pipeline in the most detail.

The Jawbone/AliphCom connection (Finding #4535: Epstein held $5 million in preferred stock, Nikolic facilitated) is sparsely documented in the corpus. What was Nikolic's specific role in that introduction, and were there other technology investments that followed the same pattern?

What further Nikolic correspondence in April–July 2018 exists in the corpus? The documented span of Nikolic–Epstein contacts ends shortly before Epstein's July 6, 2019 arrest, and additional 2018 traffic would clarify how the working contact concluded.

applicable_models.description: Cross-reference of Findings #284, #285 and the June 2013 IPI wiring email indicates Nikolic held working contacts in two loosely connected clusters (Gates Foundation scientific advisory; Epstein's personal network) and was the contact point through which the IPI grant proposal reached Foundation review. The IPI pipeline is the most fully documented instance in the corpus.

Across several documented instances, Nikolic forwarded information about third parties to Epstein: WEF participant lists in January 2011 and January 2013 [EFTA02686104][EFTA02686168][EFTA02707383], the identity of an Epstein critic at Highbridge Capital in January 2013 [Finding #699], Kimbal Musk's divorce in February 2013 [Finding #4512], and the presence of Kimbal and Elon Musk at TED in April 2017 [Finding #4512]. Whether these transmissions reflected deliberate reporting or ordinary social correspondence cannot be established from the email evidence alone.

Nikolic's placement as first alternate trustee of the 1953 Trust, ahead of Epstein's lawyers in the succession order (Indyke/Kahn → Nikolic → Marsh → Barrett → Ruemmler → Mitchell → Hanson → Eva Dubin), is a data point about how Epstein ordered personal trust in the instrument [Finding #287][Finding #378]. Nikolic declined to serve and no party has publicly explained the ordering.
